title: fix(cloud-connection): install-local seeds a composed bundle's package datasets on install, reseed, upgrade and restart
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XHBgb29oZuAnPqZyY6nR8UE)_
Fixes #34336

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：install-local 的所有样例数据入口（安装、重新灌入、升级、重启自愈、清除、计数、已装应用列表）改为同一个读法，组合包（`packages[]`）每个子包里的 seed 数据都能读到。
- **为什么改**：HotCRM 6.2 起发布的是组合包，没有顶层 `data`，托管租户装上后 订单与回款、项目交付 等模块一条演示数据都没有。
- **风险与回滚**：低。单包（平铺）读法不变，已有对照测试钉住；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 `seedDatasetsOf` 与 `applySideEffects` 第 2 步；`marketplace-install-local-composed-bundle-seeds.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-composed-bundle-seeds.test.ts`，预期 9/9 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。卡上第 2 条（升级时把新增 seed 补进所有已有组织）是新产品行为，未实现，见下方 Acceptance notes，待决定。

## What changes

Every seed door of `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` read the top-level `data` only. A composed bundle (`dist/objectstack.json` with `packages[]`, ADR-0130 D4) has no top-level `data`, so all of them answered as if the package had no sample data.

They now share one reader, `seedDatasetsOf(body)`, which is `resolveStackCollection(body, 'data')` from `@objectstack/core` filtered to datasets that name an object and carry records. It reads the top-level `data` when the body has one. Otherwise it reads every package body's `data`, in the artifact's package order (dependency order, the order the packages register in).

| Seed door | Before (composed bundle) | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| install, `POST install-local` (`applySideEffects` step 2 + 3) | `seeded: skipped / no-datasets`, nothing shared | every package body seeded, merged into `seed-datasets` |
| upgrade (re-install of a newer version) | same as install | incoming version's datasets seeded into the caller's organization (single-tenant: the database), a package the upgrade adds included |
| reseed, `POST …/reseed-sample-data` | `400 RESEED_SKIPPED no-datasets` | seeds every package body |
| restart rehydrate (`applySideEffects` with `seedNow: false`) | nothing merged for the per-organization replay | merged, so a new organization gets them |
| restart heal (`maybeHealSampleData`) | nothing to heal | heals an empty single-tenant database |
| purge, `POST …/purge-sample-data` | `400 NOTHING_TO_PURGE` | matches every package body's rows |
| count, `GET …/sample-data` | `count: 0` | counts every package body's rows |
| listing `withSampleData` | `false` | read from every package body |

The unmanaged copy (`installMode: 'unmanaged'`) is unchanged: its import refuses a multi-package artifact by name, and its doors read the seed receipt, not the body.

A malformed `packages` gets the resolver's ADR-0112 refusal, the same one the `manifest` service raises on those bytes. `applySideEffects` reports it in `seeded` (`seed-datasets-unread: …`) and does not throw, as its contract says. The listing answers `withSampleData: false` for that entry and logs it at `warn`. The heal logs it and skips.

## Tests

New file `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-composed-bundle-seeds.test.ts`, 9 cases. The composed fixture lists the order module before the core module it depends on, so package order is not array order:

- install: the loader gets `[core, o2c]`, and `seed-datasets` gets the same list;
- reseed, count, purge, listing: each door is handed `[core, o2c]`;
- upgrade 6.3.0 to 6.4.0 adding a PSA package: the loader gets all three, core first;
- restart: `seed-datasets` is refilled and the heal seeds `[core, o2c]`;
- controls: a flat bundle reads its top-level `data` unchanged; a composed artifact that still carries a flattened top-level `data` reads it once, not again per package; a composed artifact with no datasets still answers `no-datasets`.

<details><summary>Red on the base plugin source, green on the fix (HEAD f54ec13b44)</summary>

Red leg: `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` restored from `719b6b537` (base), the new test run, then restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and the blob hash checked against HEAD.

```
× install seeds every package body's datasets … (expected { mode: 'skipped', …(1) } to match object { mode: 'inline', inserted: 3 })
× reseed loads them again ({"code":"RESEED_SKIPPED","message":"Reseed did not run: no-datasets"}: expected 400 to be 200)
× an upgrade that adds a package seeds the incoming version's datasets …
× the sample-data count and the purge match the rows of every package body
× the installed-apps listing reads the package's sample data from every package body
× a restart shares them for new organizations and heals an empty database from them
Tests  6 failed | 3 passed (9)
```

Green leg: `Tests  9 passed (9)`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Card ask 2 is not built.** The card says an upgrade replays new seed keys into existing organizations, and that `sys_seed_landed_key` already keeps a deleted row from coming back. Measured on this door, for a flat bundle as well as a composed one:
  - an upgrade seeds only the organization the request acts in (or the single-tenant database). No code path replays an upgrade's seed into other existing organizations. The per-organization replayer runs only when a `sys_organization` row is inserted;
  - `runInlineSeed` builds `SeedLoaderService` with no `landedKeys` option, so this door neither reads nor writes `sys_seed_landed_key`. On this door a row a tenant deleted comes back on reinstall or reseed (create-only `ignore` default).
  So ask 2 would be new behaviour, not a fix. After this PR a composed upgrade does what a flat upgrade does: a package the upgrade adds gets its rows in the upgrading organization. The question is open on the card.
- **Same family, not changed here:** `applySideEffects` step 1 reads `translations` from the top level only. Measured on a scratch run: a composed bundle with a package-body `translations` answers `translationsLoaded: 0`, and the same translations on a flat bundle answer `1`. The ADR-0120 D5e global-unique gate (`evaluateGlobalUniqueGate`) also reads `manifest.objects` from the top level only. That one is read from the code, not measured. Both are reported to the seat.
- The seed locale's last fallback (`appDefaultSeedLocale`) still reads the composed artifact's top-level `i18n`, the same as `AppPlugin.resolveSeedLocale` does for a boot bundle. That is unchanged.
